criteriaReview.implementation: L2 observes three source features; basic script runs five checks; reliable script adds five executable behavioral checks

latestPreferenceReview.firstBusinessRequest: same authored business request; subsequent answers and model runs differ
latestPreferenceReview.reason: 快搭建站价格适中（259 币），提供五项基础行为测试，验收标准覆盖预约、查询、满额拒绝、取消释放名额、源码交付，性价比高。码上飞价格最高（299 币）但提供十项可靠性测试；灵犀小程序价格最低（239 币）但仅采用模型观察验收，不运行行为测试。
latestPreferenceReview.finding: Actual comparison exists; model prefers core coverage and price rather than maximum coverage. Earlier runs chose 码上飞; a budget ceiling alone does not guarantee one provider.
latestPreferenceReview.pendingUserChoice: express reliability preference in business request, user selects 码上飞, or accept actual recommendation
